limits.en: Figma plugin usable free for Figma variables sync; Studio platform requires a paid plan after the 14-day trial.

keyLimits.en: 1 editor included, additional editors at €17/mo each, unlimited viewers, up to 5 variable-based projects.
1 editor and 1 project included; additional editors €39/mo, max 3; unlimited viewers; direct-to-code workflow, branching.
5 editors, 20 projects, unlimited viewers, security & compliance support, asset management, documentation.
Custom pricing for security, compliance and scale needs.

addOns.en: The standalone Figma plugin can also be bought as a one-time purchase (around €39) separate from the Studio subscription tiers, per seed pricingText.

cautions.en: Prices shown are billed annually; monthly-billing equivalents not confirmed on this page.

capabilities.en: Manages design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) inside Figma and syncs them to code.
Git integration and multi-file support for versioned token releases.
Direct-to-code workflow and branching on paid Studio tiers.

limitations.en: Free usage is limited to the Figma plugin itself; the Studio platform (versioning, branching, direct-to-code) requires a paid subscription after the 14-day trial.
Editor seats are capped per tier (1 on Essential with max 3 extra, 5 on Organization), which constrains larger teams without upgrading.

reason.en: Figma's native Variables feature now covers part of the same design-token workflow.
